translation: Flavor sweet, warm, toxic. It governs brightening the eyes, benefiting the ears, extreme cold within the abdomen, breaking hard bindings and rat fistula (鼠瘻), and killing the hundred insects and evil beasts. Taken for a long time, one name is 倉石 (cāngshí), one name is 石 (yùshí), one name is 鼠毒 (shǔdú).
